page.overview:
Who is Onia?

Onia, or Conia, is a former grunt of the Explorers who is also one of Amethio's subordinates and a former antagonist appearing in .

Onia has gray blue hair and eyebrows, and blue eyes. Her usual Explorers outfit consists of a grayish suit with an Explorers symbol on the left side of her outer shirt. She wears black skirts with light gray legwear and gray high heels.

When in her casual clothes during PH103, she wore a pale yellow shirt, a golden jumper, and a red bag.

Despite being part of the Explorers, Onia has been shown to be warmhearted, taking good care of Liko's Sprigatito when it was captured by Amethio. She was quick to give Sprigatito whatever it wanted such as food and toys. Onia tends to hide this side of herself, where she was quickly embarrassed after Amethio saw her playing with Sprigatito. Even when confronting it on the island, Onia didn't wish to have to fight the Grass Cat Pokémon and wanted it for herself.
